release_part_inventory.description: Public inventory of 57 annotated-text Zstandard volumes stored as GitHub Release attachments.

storage.this_directory_contains: Source inventory, documentation, and verified decompressed TXT volumes under unpacked/; consult unpacked/progress.json for actual completed scope.

sources.verification_scope: Per-volume metadata was reconciled between the public annotation inventory, public Release inventory, and archived toolkit manifest. Byte and row totals are supported by the archived full verification report; this inventory does not claim a new full decompression or a Lean kernel check.

format.decompressed_format: UTF-8 text; one annotation line followed by one original NDJSON record line.
format.source_line_numbering: first_line, last_line, records, and the @line labels refer to 1-based physical record lines in the original NDJSON. Numbers remain consecutive across volumes.
format.annotated_physical_line_numbering: Each original record produces two physical lines: its annotation and its unchanged JSON line.
format.line_number_scope: Record numbers identify exported data records; they are not mathematical proof-step numbers.
format.maximum_line_status: Not recorded in the available complete-data manifests or verification reports.

size_planning.chunk_count_scope: Counts are exact for arbitrary byte boundaries with no added headers. They are lower bounds for chunks that preserve whole lines or annotation/JSON pairs.
size_planning.note: Chunking reduces individual file size but does not reduce total text content. Actual Git object size, pack size, and upload cost are not implied by the Zstandard sizes. No repository-wide hard size limit is asserted here.

annotation_progress.boundary: whole annotation plus original JSON record pairs; bytes preserved
annotation_progress.verification_scope: Every complete source volume is SHA-256 checked before decompression; each original-volume hash, record count, byte count and line-label sequence is rechecked. Every output chunk is SHA-256 checked and its Git blob SHA-1 is compared with Git. No Lean proof checking.

current_tool_version.source_buffer: Linux sealed memfd; at most 336997274 bytes per worker
current_tool_version.api_transport: httpx persistent HTTP/1.1; system SSL context; urllib HTTPS proxy routing

scope.description: This read-only check verifies remote immutable Git trees and small metadata against the upload manifests and source catalog. Chunk payload SHA-256 values and volume hashes were checked during upload; this check compares those recorded hashes and remote Git blob identifiers. It does not download the 168 GB TXT payloads again, compute a new global original SHA-256, or verify a Lean proof. Release/ref state is an observation, not a lock against later user changes.
